points: The difference between AI, machine learning, deep learning and generative AI

pageFaq.q: What is a large language model (LLM)?
pageFaq.a: A large language model is a type of AI trained on vast amounts of text. It learns statistical patterns in language — which words follow which — and uses those patterns to generate, summarise, translate and answer questions. GPT-4, Claude and Gemini are all LLMs. They do not understand language the way people do; they predict the most likely next token given what came before.

pageFaq.q: What is an AI agent?
pageFaq.a: An AI agent is a system that uses an LLM to plan and take actions, not just respond. Given a goal, it breaks the goal into steps, calls tools (a search engine, a database, an API, a browser), acts on the results, and repeats until the task is done. A chatbot replies; an agent acts. Most practical AI agents today use Claude, GPT-4 or Gemini as their reasoning core.

pageFaq.q: Can I build AI tools without a computer science degree?
pageFaq.a: Yes. Modern AI APIs (Claude, OpenAI, Gemini) are designed to be called from any programming language with a few lines of code. No-code tools like n8n and Make.com let non-developers wire AI into workflows. The hard part today is designing the right prompt and knowing when AI is and is not the right tool — not the mathematics behind it.

points: Turning visitors into enquiries: forms, phone and WhatsApp links, calls to action, chat, analytics

pageFaq.q: Is the website audit really free?
pageFaq.a: Yes. There is no sign-up and no email is asked for. If you want the issues fixed, you can send the report to me and I reply with a fixed quote within one working day.

pageFaq.q: What does the audit actually check?
pageFaq.a: It requests your public homepage once, plus robots.txt and sitemap.xml, and runs a fixed set of checks on what comes back: enquiry paths, search tags, speed, mobile setup and security headers. Every finding shows the evidence behind it.

pageFaq.q: Does an AI decide my score?
pageFaq.a: No. The score is the sum of visible pass, improve or fix results from those checks. Nothing is guessed, and anything that cannot be measured, such as content built in the browser, is left out of the score rather than counted against you.

pageFaq.q: Is it a full Lighthouse or SEO crawl?
pageFaq.a: No. It looks at one page, and speed means how fast your server sent that page to mine, not what a visitor on a phone sees. Treat it as a fast first look at what is costing you enquiries, not a complete technical audit.

pageFaq.q: Does it store my website or my details?
pageFaq.a: No. Nothing is saved. The address is used for the audit and discarded. You only share details with me if you choose to send the report.
